narrative.headline: Healthcare flow dominates with concentrated bullish positioning across pharma, biotech, and managed care — while industrials and consumer staples show only token participation.
bullish_themes: Healthcare is the day's flow magnet: large-cap pharma (LLY, ABBV, MRK), biotech (MRNA, IBRX), specialty pharma (HIMS), and managed care (CNC, MOH, UNH) all printing bullish
Credit Services pair trade: PYPL and V both 100% bullish with multi-handed ask-side participation
Airlines showing coordinated bid (LUV + UAL) — small premium but consistent directional read on XLI
Consumer staples bullish skew is narrow — MNST and WMT printing single ask-side prints, COST mixed at 47% bullish
notable_individual_flows: LLY — $1.89M premium, 100% bullish, 5 ask-side prints: highest-conviction large-cap name on the tape
MRNA — $1.04M premium with 12 ask-side bullish prints: heaviest repeat-buyer signature in the scan
PYPL — $522K at 100% bullish with 8 ask-side prints: strongest fintech conviction
HIMS — $560K, 6 ask-side prints at 93.5% bullish: standout in specialty pharma
UNH — $2.89M premium but only 74% bullish: largest notional, diluted conviction
narrative.absences: Zero bullish flow in Technology (XLK) or Communication Services (XLC) despite broad index participation. Energy and Materials also silent. Bearish prints clustered in diagnostics/medical devices (TMO, ISRG, TMDX) and private prisons (GEO, CXW) — notable counter-tape to the healthcare bull theme.
